target.title: fix: SQLite-backed sessions never trigger byte-based auto-compaction
target.body:
Closes #104762

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where SQLite-backed sessions never trigger the `maxActiveTranscriptBytes` auto-compaction guard. Every migrated session silently falls back to token-only compaction triggering, so a session with a huge but low-token-count transcript (e.g. large tool output) never gets size-based compaction.

## Why This Change Was Made

`readSessionLogSnapshot` in `src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory.ts` returned `{}` early for `sqlite:` session markers (the legacy JSONL tail scan is intentionally skipped for SQLite-backed transcripts), so the byte-guard path saw `undefined` transcript bytes. The SQLite marker already encodes the agent/session/store identity needed to answer this, so the fix wires that branch to `readTranscriptStatsSync(...).sizeBytes` — one accessor call, no schema changes, no behavior change for JSONL-backed sessions.

## User Impact

Users on SQLite-backed sessions (the current default) now get real byte-based auto-compaction the same way JSONL-backed sessions always have. No config changes needed.

## Evidence

- [x] `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory.test.ts` — 51/51 pass, including a new regression test that seeds a real SQLite transcript and asserts compaction triggers via the `budget` reason once `maxActiveTranscriptBytes` is exceeded.
- [x] Confirmed the new test fails without the fix (reverted the source change locally, test failed with `expected +0 to be 1` on `compactionCount`), then restored the fix and reran green.
- [x] `pnpm tsgo:core` and `pnpm tsgo:core:test` clean.
- [x] `codex review --uncommitted` — no actionable findings.
- [x] Live runtime proof (real SQLite reads/writes and the real unmodified `runPreflightCompactionIfNeeded` guard, only the final model-backed `compactEmbeddedAgentSession` call stubbed since this environment has no provider API key): before-fix run shows `activeTranscriptBytes=undefined sizeTrigger=false`, after-fix run shows `activeTranscriptBytes=4153 sizeTrigger=true trigger=transcript_bytes` and `compactionCount: 1`. Full logs in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104940#issuecomment-4956660704
